title: What if you could teleport? There's a catch
idea: There's a catch, episode 9: the best man can teleport home for the forgotten rings, but every jump leaves behind the last thing he touched (his bow tie, the rings, the box, his leaf); the bride is twenty steps away

hook.what: a garden wedding: the best man snaps the ring box open, it is empty, the bride is far down the aisle walking toward them

props.staged: slid onto her glove in the close shot

do.reason: the box snaps open: empty

do.line: No rings. She's twenty steps away.
You can teleport. Every jump keeps one thing.
